response.text: Two anomalies to note: 2 journals posted outside their period's date range, and 1 paid invoice whose payments don't match its amount. There are also 2 undocumented columns. I'll identify them quickly.

arguments.sql: SELECT c.table_name, c.column_name FROM information_schema.columns c WHERE c.table_schema='public' AND c.table_name<>'SYSDICT' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "SYSDICT" d WHERE d."TBL_NM"=c.table_name AND d."COL_NM"=c.column_name) UNION ALL SELECT 'MISMATCH_INV', i."INV_ID"::text || ' inv=' || i."INV_AMT"::text || ' paid=' || (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p."PAY_AMT"),0) FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID")::text FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."STAT_CD"='P' AND i."INV_AMT"<>(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p."PAY_AMT"),0) FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID") UNION ALL SELECT 'OUT_OF_PERIOD', h."JRNL_NO"::text || ' prd=' || h."PRD_ID"::text || ' dt=' || h."POST_DT"::text FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT";
